text:
Maya L: FYI inc-bot didn't page the oncall for a 504 impacting /api/generate in us-west for ~6m. Customers reported timeouts.
Tom B: Any alerts in alert-orch? did the webhook fire?
Dan O: I'm seeing a bunch of 401s from Pagerly on the webhooks. timestamped logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z ALERT -> /integrations/pagerly 401 Unauthorized token=stale_token_abc
2026-03-17T14:12:04Z ALERT -> /integrations/pagerly 401 Unauthorized token=stale_token_abc
```
Ops Bot: integration/pagerly: webhook delivery failed (401) — last 20m. suppressor/mute-check: channel #incidents is muted by schedule id=ms-983 (expires in 23h) :mute:
Sasha R: @Maya are you oncall? I didn't get a page either.
Maya L: I'm oncall but wasn't paged. I just saw the thread. Manual page sent to rotation (call + sms) — pinged primary.
Tom B: The token rotation job ran last night but the secret sync to alert-orch failed (403 from secrets API). The alert-orch kept using the old token and Pagerly rejected it.
Dan O: Confirmed: secret-manager logs show 2026-03-17T02:03:21Z sync FAILED 403. Ops tried retry but backoff queue stuck.
Maya L: Customer impact: ~4 customers with production traffic got 504s. We mitigated by falling back to standby region after failover at 14:18. Window ~6m, postmortem will include cost/latency slides.
Sasha R: Immediate mitigations: (1) rotate pagerly token manually and update alert-orch, (2) unmute #incidents now so on-call sees follow-ups, (3) patch secret-sync job to stop swallowing 403s.
Tom B: Doing (1) now — generating token, updating alert-orch config: `curl -X POST https://alert-orch/rotate -d '{"provider":"pagerly"}'` -> 200.
Ops Bot: alert-orch webhook health: OK (200) after config reload. Delivery resumed.
Dan O: Unmuting #incidents — reason: missed pages during live outage. Found scheduler bug: when schedule API returns timezone as "UTC+0" rather than "Z" we treat as all-day mute. Working on fix.
Maya L: Good catch. Also add a healthcheck alert for webhook 4xx -> page admins when >3 failures in 5m.
Sasha R: I'll handle customer comms summary. Assigning follow-ups: Dan -> fix mute parser + tests, Tom -> make secret-sync job alert on 403, Maya -> post incident summary and add evals for failover timeliness.
Maya L: Thanks all. I'll create a retro ticket and link runbook edits. :thumbsup:
Ops Bot: Incident closed in thread, root cause: secret-sync failed during token rotation, resulting in webhook 401s and combined with a mute-scheduler timezone parse bug causing channel to stay muted; manual pages sent and failover executed. Follow-ups created: ENG-1234 ENG-1235 ENG-1236
